d: Addressing a rally of traders at Chandni Chowk in Delhi, Bharatiya Janata Party National President Nitin Nabin affirmed that Indian democracy remains entirely secure under Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Drawing an analogy to the traditional ledger books balanced by businessmen ahead of Diwali, Nabin likened the electoral rolls to democracy's ledger, declaring that legitimate citizens will be enrolled while illegal infiltrators and duplicate entries will be expunged. Launching a sharp attack on Congress leader Rahul Gandhi, Nabin accused the opposition of ignoring constitutional principles…
